response.sql: SELECT mt.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice), AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT) / t.Milliseconds) FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name

assumptions.assumption: Division of Bytes by Milliseconds must use floating point arithmetic rather than integer division to preserve decimal precision as requested

alternatives.interpretation: The phrase 'average of file size divided by track length' could mean the ratio of total file size to total track length (aggregate metric) rather than the average of per-track ratios
alternatives.sql: SELECT mt.Name, AVG(t.UnitPrice), SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS FLOAT)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) FROM Track t INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name
